slides.title: One key expires. **10,000 requests** hit your DB.
3 ways a cache **fails**
bullets: 🏔️|**Avalanche**: many keys (or the cache) fail together

slides.title: What happens
flow: 💥 All query the DB at once
🔥 DB slows, more requests pile up

slides.title: Only **one** should rebuild
bullets: 🤝|**Single-flight**: merge duplicate calls in the app

slides.title: A simple Redis lock
slides.text: Give it a TTL and a random token. Re-check the cache after you get the lock.
slides.code:
SET lock:user:42 <token> NX PX 5000
→ OK  : I rebuild, then release
→ nil : wait, re-read cache
Release only if token matches (Lua)

slides.title: Keys that **don't exist**
bullets: 🗒️|**Cache the empty result** (30 to 60 s TTL)
🌸|**Bloom filter** of valid IDs in front

slides.title: Everything expires **together**
bullets: 🛟|Replicas / Cluster, so a node loss is not total
🧯|Rate limit and circuit-break to protect the DB

slides.title: Say this in 1 line
slides.text: **Stampede**: lock or serve stale. **Penetration**: cache nulls and use a **Bloom filter**. **Avalanche**: **TTL jitter**, a highly available cache, and rate limits to protect the DB.
